学习库：今天学什么: Study library: what to study today

在原文里提问、出题: Ask and make questions right in the original
出题需要先配置 AI 模型，导览快结束时会告诉你在哪里设置。: Making questions needs an AI model. Near the end, the tour shows where to set one up.
AI 出的题先放进草稿。你可以逐题核对、修改或删除，确认无误再发布，发布后就能开: New questions land in a draft first. Check, edit or delete each one, then publish when you are happy and start practising. This is a sample draft.
选择题会逐项说明对在哪、错在哪；闪卡先回忆再翻面自评。每次作答后，系统按记忆曲线: Multiple-choice questions explain why each option is right or wrong; flashcards ask you to recall, flip and rate yourself. After each answer, the next review is scheduled on a forgetting curve. Try answering one.
后台助教会结合原文讲解这道题、补上前置知识。讲解完成后送进信箱，不打断你做题。: A background tutor explains the question from the source and fills in what you need to know first. The explanation arrives in your inbox, so your practice is not interrupted.

学习流：先讲后练: Learning flow: learn first, then practise

每门课可以记下考试形式、总分、作答和阅读时间、考试日期，课程标题旁会显示距考试还: Each course can record its exam format, total marks, writing and reading time and exam date; the course heading shows how many days are left. Choose “Course settings…” at the end of this heading’s menu to add your lecturer’s exam briefing and focus topics — case papers, grading and mock exams follow them.
左侧按用到的频率分成三组：「每天」是每次学习都会用的（回到题目、学习库、错题与待: The sidebar has three groups, by how often you use them. “Every day” is what you open each session (return to question, the study library, mistakes, study flows, notes, to-dos). “Now and then” is what you open once in a while (mock exams, statistics). “Course setup & management” is what you do once when a course starts (materials, create questions, knowledge skeleton, audio transcription, live class). Click the titles of the last two to fold them. Language and appearance are at the bottom, and holding an item and dragging reorders it.
PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Markdown、网页和文本都可以导入，: Import PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Markdown, web pages or plain text; the original file is kept intact. One document is one source, so a multi-page PDF stays in one piece, and a textbook of hundreds of pages gets a hint to convert it to paged text first.
这是示例讲义的原文。标出的段落已经关联了题目和解析；选中任意一段文字，就能就这段: This is the sample lecture itself. Marked passages are already linked to questions and explanations. Select any passage to ask about it or to turn it into questions; “Generate from this source” at the top right uses the whole document.
勾选要出题的资料；资料多时可以按名称筛选，转换过的大教材用「选择章节」只选这次要: Tick the sources to write questions from. With many sources you can filter by name, and a converted textbook lets you choose only the chapters you want with “Choose chapters”. Questions you already have can be imported with the second entry at the top of the page.
题型、题数、难度一次选好: Set type, count and difficulty in one place
题型、难度和语言是开关，题数用加减按钮。不知道练什么？点「帮我想想」，它只发送资: Type, difficulty and language are switches, and the count has plus and minus buttons. Not sure what to practise? Choose “Suggest a focus”: it sends only source titles and outlines, never full text, and without a model it suggests from your own mistakes instead.
开始前先看一眼用量: Check the usage before you start
摘要行写明这次出什么题；「预计 … tok」是按真实提示词估算的 token 用: The summary line spells out what this run will make; “Estimated … tok” is a token estimate built from the real prompts. When it finishes, the job's “Actual usage” lists what was really used, including cache hits.
错题与待巩固：举一反三: Mistakes & weak points: learn by analogy
答错或自评没掌握的题会按主题收好。「为你推荐」直接从题库里找相似的题，不消耗模型: Questions you got wrong or rated as not yet known are grouped by topic. “Recommended for you” finds similar questions already in your bank without using a model; to practise again, generate variants of a mistake (needs a model) or retrain in one click.
在这里切换选择题笔试、案例分析卷和口头面试，都是限时作答。交卷后给出成绩单和逐题: Switch here between the multiple-choice exam, the case paper and the oral interview; all are timed. When you hand in, you get a score report with an explanation for every question, and a case paper is graded criterion by criterion. The sample has a case already graded.
分数趋势、未来 14 天的到期复习预测和各主题的掌握程度都在这里，页面底部的「模: The score trend, a 14-day forecast of due reviews and your mastery by topic are here, and “Model usage” at the bottom lists token use by feature. The charts show the sample's three weeks of practice.
按「讲解 → 复述 → 练习」一步步学一个主题，学到一半离开也能接着学。默认用当: Study a topic step by step, from lesson to retelling to practice, and pick up where you left off. It uses the current course's sources by default; to change course, choose “Switch course” after you start. The sample has a flow paused at its lesson.
上百页的大教材，建议先用转换工具变成带页码的文字再导入；整本书出题时，可以让 D: For a textbook of hundreds of pages, convert it to paged text first and then import it; for a whole book, a search tool in DSH can pick out only the relevant pages. “About and updates” below checks for a new version, and the bottom of the sidebar also says when one is available.
